people.name: Lalgudi Jayaraman
people.extract: Lalgudi Gopal Jayaraman was an Indian Carnatic violinist, vocalist and composer. He is commonly grouped with M.S. Gopalakrishnan and T.N.Krishnan as part of the violin trinity of Carnatic music. He was awarded the Padma Bhushan by the Government of India in 2001.
highlights: Indian Carnatic violinist, vocalist and composer.
Part of the violin trinity of Carnatic music.

people.name: Thomas J. Bata
people.extract: Tomáš Jan Baťa,, also known as Thomas Bata Jr. and Tomáš Baťa ml., was a Czech and Canadian businessman and philanthropist. He ran the Bata Shoe Company from the 1940s until the 80s.
highlights: Ran the Bata Shoe Company from the 1940s until the 80s.

people.name: Duje Ćaleta-Car
people.extract: Duje Ćaleta-Car is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Sassuolo and the Croatia national team.
highlights: Plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Sassuolo.
Plays for the Croatia national team.
